assumptions.choice: The 10-candle consolidation window and its upper/lower boundaries are computed from the 10 bars strictly prior to the current (breakout) bar; the breakout candle itself is not included in the range calculation.
assumptions.reason: Including the current candle's own high/low in the boundary would make it nearly impossible for its close to exceed a boundary derived from itself; excluding it is the only reading that makes the breakout condition satisfiable.

assumptions.choice: TP and SL exits are checked against intrabar High/Low ('reaching' a level), while the range-boundary exit is checked against Close ('closes below/above').
assumptions.reason: The spec uses distinct wording: TP/SL say 'reaching' a level from entry, while the range-invalidation exit explicitly says 'closes below/above' — the wording difference is taken as intentional.

assumptions.choice: Size in shares = (1% of current broker portfolio value) / current close price, passed via buy(size=...)/sell(size=...).
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly overrides the canonical default sizer by stating position size must be 1% of total trading capital; portfolio value is re-evaluated at each entry decision.

assumptions.choice: Volume condition uses >= (current volume at least 3x the 20-period volume SMA).
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'at least 3 times', which is inclusive of exactly 3x.

assumptions.choice: Not implemented; strategy evaluates every daily bar.
assumptions.reason: infeasible - the feed is daily OHLCV bars with no intraday timestamps, so there is no session/time-of-day information to filter on.

assumptions.choice: Implemented via the same 2% stop-loss check listed in the exit conditions; no separate broker-level stop order is placed.
assumptions.reason: Spec restates the 2% stop-loss as 'mandatory' without specifying a different mechanism, so it is treated as identical to the stated exit condition rather than an additional stop-order requirement.
